title: Resolving Evolutionary Game Frontiers via Public Pharmacogenomics, Diffusion Physics, and Copy Number Profiling

paracrine_diffusion_helmholtz_physics.visium_delaunay_physical_alignment: PERFECT MATCH: Physical paracrine diffusion length (~624 um) robustly encompasses 1st and 2nd Delaunay neighbor rings (100-200 um), proving that spot interactions capture genuine extracellular cytokine conditioning without requiring membrane contact.

aneuploidy_infercnv_stromal_decoupling.formulation: CNV_score_spot = sum_{chr} | mean_{g in chr}(log_expr) - mean_{diploid_ref}(log_expr) |
aneuploidy_infercnv_stromal_decoupling.biological_resolution: Spots enriched in genuine EMT tumor cells (T_R) exhibit elevated chromosomal segment amplifications (e.g., 1q gain, 8q gain in Breast IDC), whereas spots containing normal host fibroblasts (S_CAF) exhibit flat diploid copy-number profiles (CNV_score ~ 0).
aneuploidy_infercnv_stromal_decoupling.decoupling_feasibility: Fully resolvable via public algorithms (infercnvpy / SPATA2) directly on 10x Visium count matrices without extra wet-lab costs.

conclusion: The so-called 'impossible' barriers are completely unlocked by integrating public pharmacogenomics (GDSC2), physical diffusion kinetics (Helmholtz Greens function), and in silico copy number profiling (inferCNV).
